name: Celica Sylphil
source: A priest warrior of the Barouhart Temple. With a pure heart of justice, excellent swordsmanship, and magical abilities with great potential, people also refer to him as a hero. However, he doesn't like to be called a hero, he simply draws his sword to protect the happiness of other people. He doesn't care about himself much, and his daily life is fairly sloppy.
